global.title: Trump is right: EV range anxiety is a disease – THIS is how we cure it!
global.summary: On today’s time-sensitive episode of Quick Charge, we revisit the idea that even a broken clock is right twice a day as we examine US President Donald Trump’s takes on electric vehicles, range anxiety, highway road signs, and why he’s absolutely right.

global.title: Global EV sales rose in July – except in North America
global.summary: Global EV sales rose 9% in July, but the growth map couldn’t look more uneven.

global.title: Tesla plans massive new V4 Supercharger in San Francisco
global.summary: Tesla wants to build one of its biggest Superchargers yet right in the middle of San Francisco. Planning permits have been filed for a 124-stall V4 station on the city’s south side. global.title: US EV prices are going back up as discounts shrink
global.summary: After six straight months of year-over-year declines, the average transaction price (ATP) paid for a new EV in the US is rising again.

global.title: As EV sales, oil costs and temperatures spike, UK gov’t considers… fewer EVs?
global.summary: The UK government is considering relaxing its landmark electric vehicle rules, even in the face of inflated oil prices, a recordbreaking year for temperatures and wildfires, and EV sales that are already rising fast enough to meet the government’s current target.

global.title: BYD’s new electric sedan is the size of a Tesla Model 3, but half the price
global.summary: BYD’s new sedan is about the size of a Tesla Model 3, but it’s half the cost in China. The new Seal 06 went on sale in China, starting at just 109,900 yuan, or about $16,500.

global.title: Lectric XP Lite2 e-bike + largest $508 bundle from $999, Anker SOLIX 3,840Wh F3800 power station $1,800, EcoFlow, tools, more
global.summary: Leading our midweek Green Deals pack is a spotlight on the largest bundle in 2026 on Lectric’s XP Lite2 Long-Range Folding Lightweight e-bikes with $508 in FREE gear from $999 that is one of several solid deals from the brand’s Back to School Sale. global.title: Volkswagen launches the ID.3 Neo in the UK with up to 390 miles of range
global.summary: Volkswagen announced that prices for the ID.3 Neo will start at £33,080 ($45,000). The electric hatch is bringing an all-new look inside and out, a longer driving range, and Volkswagen’s latest tech and software.

global.title: EVgo + GM open 350 kW flagship charging for EVs with trailers
global.summary: EVgo and GM have opened a new flagship DC fast-charging station near Detroit with 12 high-power stalls, CCS and NACS connectors, and pull-through charging for EVs towing trailers.

global.title: The strange story behind Colorado’s ‘no catch’ free e-bike company
global.summary: It started as one of the most talked-about e-bike deals in the country. Colorado residents could get what was advertised as a “free” electric bike by applying the state’s e-bike tax credit, with Bear Trail Bikes matching the discount. Customers were generally left paying little more than sales tax.
